free_tier.stated: Free plan $0 a month: single user, 2 active devices maximum, 30 minutes refilled monthly and a 3-minute session limit; capacity is throttled.
free_tier.notes: A month of streaming time is counted across all uploaded apps; the annual-billed Starter price is $59 a month and Premium $319 a month.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a streamed mobile-device session, not a stored object; no per-app upload size cap is stated on the pricing page.

retention.stated: A session ends when the user leaves the page or times out from inactivity; the free plan has a 3-minute session limit. Uploaded app retention is not stated on the pricing page.

egress.terms: No egress allowance or per-GB price is published: billing is by streaming time, and paid plans charge $0.06 per minute beyond the 500 included minutes. Network Proxy and Debug Logs are listed as a plan feature; a data-transfer charge is not stated.

interface_detail: Native iOS and Android apps stream into a browser with no download, plugin or permission; the plan table lists API Access and Reporting API, and apps can be embedded or shared by link. An API endpoint is not published on the pricing page.
tooling: A browser is the client; the emulator runs on Appetize's cloud. AppRecorder and Playwright automation is a listed feature; API Access and a Reporting API are plan features. No software is installed and run by the user for the hosted plans.
chaining: A hosted mobile-device emulator for demos, support and testing, driven from a browser or its API; streamed sessions are billed in minutes and do not provide a general storage or egress allowance, so app artifacts need a separate object-storage record.

limits.value: 30 minutes of streaming a month on Free, refilled monthly; paid tiers include 500 minutes then $0.06 per minute
3-minute session limit on Free; unlimited on Starter, Premium and Enterprise
2 active devices at once on Free, 3 on Starter and 16 on Premium
Free capacity is throttled and users are queued when no device is available

limits_note: A single user on Free; paid plans are $59 a month Starter or $319 a month Premium when billed annually, and Enterprise is custom. Video recording and an SLA are listed as features.
binding_note: The 3-minute session limit binds first on Free: with only 30 minutes a month it allows ten sessions, and a longer test is cut off mid-run while the monthly minute balance is still largely unused.

identity_cost.detail: The sign-up form asks for a Work Email address, runs a reCAPTCHA and sends an email verification step; Google and GitHub sign-up are offered as alternatives. The login page accepts an email and password or Google and GitHub. Stripe is named as the payments provider for paid plans; no card is collected at the free sign-up form.

reliability_note: Free capacity is throttled and a user is queued when no device is available; sessions time out from inactivity. The vendor states a 99.9% uptime SLA.
confidence_note: Prices, minutes, device counts and session limits are quoted from Appetize's own pricing page read on 2026-11-24; the sign-up gate is quoted from the sign-up page itself.
